contract.intended_consumer: Brian and his coding agents continuing real Brian-owned Enforced Planning work
contract.outcome: An explicitly opted-in lifecycle renewal or write succeeds only while its exact selected classed outcome has an active portfolio allocation and continuing lease.

canonical_journey.starting_state: The exact Plan 122 claim is live and the production admission owner is implemented, but no Plan 122 allocation or selection exists.
canonical_journey.input: One Project Graph-bound maintenance allocation, one exact selected scenario, and an ordinarily authorized write to the production owner.
canonical_journey.action: Allocate and select the outcome, then invoke the public selected decision, heartbeat, and pre-write commands with hard admission enabled.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Active state returns outcome_admission_active and both protected commands succeed; missing or circular state returns nonzero before protected success.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: The caller can self-certify active state, approval text or cost overrides the lease, or a denied outcome still renews or returns pre-write success.
